dct_description_sm: A collection of maps issued or reissued by the Dépôt général de la marine between 1778 and 1780 and published for the use of the French navy during the American Revolutionary War.

A collection of maps issued or reissued by the Dépôt général de la marine between 1778 and 1780 and published for the use of the French navy during the American Revolutionary War. Relief shown by hachures and pictorially. Depths shown by soundings. Engraved title page, 26 engraved maps on 31 leaves, 5 maps printed on double leaves. Bound in brown leather. List of geographical atlases in the Library of Congress, 1211 LC maps of North America, 1750-1789, 216.2 1/2, 2/2 Sabin, 52337 Provenance: Gift of Jay I. Kislak Foundation. Kislak accession no. 2000.126.00.0002 (Copy 1)
Contributors: France. Dépôt des Cartes, Plans, Journaux et Mémoires Relatifs à la Navigation; Jay I. Kislak Collection (Library of Congress)
